items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: And I already told Eddie Monteiro who is a wonderful piano player, I said, “You’d better get ahold of a bunch of records

ctx.x: Is that being at the right place at the right time? And you know there’s going to be a lot of wine drinking and you know that he’s going to sing. Of course he’s going to sing you know. And I already told Eddie Monteiro who is a wonderful piano player, I said, “You’d better get ahold of a bunch of records, because you know he’s going to say ‘O Sole Mio, D flat’”—boom.
Man, that’s pressure. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -17-
